about: The inputs the grib profile rejects, each with the start of its message (the Rust tests' prefix, or what each store test's message contains). rust/refkv-ir/build.rs writes a Rust test per case into tests/grib.rs; python/tests/ir/test_rejects.py checks each through the host and that every rejected fixture is listed here.
